question:
Select the word that is closest in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below.

CAJOLE
solution:
The **correct answer **is **Option 2 i.e. 'Persuade'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cajole**: To cajole someone is to persuade them to do something by flattery or gentle, but persistent, argument.(मनाना)

 
 
• **Example**: She managed to cajole her parents into letting her borrow the car for the weekend.
 
 
 
• **Persuade**: To persuade someone is to cause them to do something through reasoning or argument.(मनाना )
 
 
• **Example**: He persuaded his friend to go back to school and finish her degree.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dissuade**: To dissuade someone is to convince them not to do something. (मना करना)

 
 
• **Example**: He tried to dissuade his brother from taking the risky job.
 
 
 
• **Bully**: To bully someone involves using force, threat, or coercion to abuse, intimidate, or aggressively dominate others.(धमकाना)
 
 
• **Example**: The new policy aims to prevent students from bullying others in school.
 
 
 
• **Disenchant**: To disenchant someone is to free (someone) from illusion; to disappoint or disillusion.(मोहभंग करना)
 
 
• **Example**: The harsh realities of the work disenchant many newcomers.
